mentions.name: Marginalia index C++ port
mentions.description: A C++ port of Marginalia's search index code. The rewrite incorporates optimizations that drastically cut pointer chasing and relies primarily on an io_uring-based buffer pool population strategy with rare naked preads.
mentions.source_excerpt: Porting marginalia's index code to C++.  Been staring at the code for so long I've found optimizations that will drastically cut pointer chasing, necessitating a primarily io_uring-based buffer pool population strategy with rare naked preads.
mentions.author: marginalia_nu
